name: Bhaderwah & the Meadow Roads
description: A longer hill-country proposal, designed around local conditions and quiet days.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Jammu
itinerary.description: Meet your arranged transfer and settle into your stay. Keep the day flexible around arrival and rest.

itinerary.title: Journey to Bhaderwah
itinerary.description: Travel towards Bhaderwah with realistic breaks and a relaxed evening on arrival.

itinerary.title: A valley day
itinerary.description: Discuss a local sightseeing circuit and suitable village walks with the operator.

itinerary.title: Meadow roads
itinerary.description: Choose a meadow excursion only if the road is open and local advice supports the plan. Keep a lower-altitude alternative ready.

itinerary.title: Return through the hills
itinerary.description: Travel towards Patnitop for a final hill stay and a quieter evening.

itinerary.title: Until next time
itinerary.description: Check out and take the arranged transfer for your onward journey. Departure timings and road buffers will be confirmed in your proposal.
